items.title: Write concrete root Markdown migration execution solution
items.context: Create a decision doc that turns the prior classification guide into an execution plan: allowed root files, batch order, canonical destinations, stub/delete rules, reference-update checks, and validation gates. KOALA.md must be treated as a retirement target, not as a permanent root file.
items.userSees: User sees the document title "Root Markdown Migration Execution Solution" and a section "Final Allowed Root Markdown Set" listing only README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG.md, and jek.md.

happy.desc: Execution solution defines the final allowed root Markdown set as README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG.md, and user-owned jek.md only.

edge.desc: Execution solution separates low-risk migration batch from high-risk capability and Production Safety boundary/history handling without claiming unlocks.

adversarial.desc: Execution solution treats the legacy Koala root guide as a retirement target, not as an allowed root compatibility asset.

items.title: Align existing root migration guide with no-KOALA root policy
items.context: Update the existing guide so its allowed-root policy no longer says KOALA.md may stay root. The guide should preserve README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG.md, and user-owned jek.md as allowed root files, while classifying agent-generated root docs for migration or retirement.
items.userSees: User sees docs/requirements/decisions/root-document-migration-guide.md aligned with the no-KOALA retained-root policy and no longer presenting the legacy Koala root guide as a permitted stay-root compatibility asset.

happy.desc: Existing migration guide names jek.md as user-owned and allowed to remain root while generated Lattice docs are migration candidates.

edge.desc: Existing migration guide preserves README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and CHANGELOG.md as allowed root files but does not retain the legacy Koala root guide.

adversarial.desc: Existing migration guide does not contain language that the legacy Koala root guide may stay root or remain a compatibility asset after cleanup.
